note: Public, review-only monetization opportunities. A listing here is not an endorsement, sponsorship, approval, or guarantee of eligibility. YouTube lanes are retained but inactive until the owner re-enables them.

opportunities.name: YouTube Creator Partnerships
opportunities.evidence: Eligible YPP creators can be discovered by brands, receive campaign inquiries, use a media kit, and set preferred rates in YouTube Studio.

opportunities.name: YouTube Creator Partnerships Open Call
opportunities.evidence: Invite-only Open Call projects let eligible creators submit Shorts for advertiser selection and payment through AdSense if selected.

opportunities.name: Kidrobot Affiliate Program
opportunities.evidence: Kidrobot offers approved publishers 5% base commission with tiered opportunities up to 10% through Rakuten Advertising, covering designer collectibles, plush, blind boxes, art toys, and collaborations.

opportunities.name: Entertainment Earth Affiliate Program
opportunities.evidence: Entertainment Earth publicly offers affiliates 7% to 10% cash commission based on monthly referred sales, with trackable links usable on websites, blogs, and social media.
requirements: compliant website, blog, or social promotion

opportunities.name: The Connect by StockX
opportunities.evidence: StockX describes The Connect as an ambassador program with up to 3% sales commission, performance-based monthly cash bonuses, site credit, events, gifting for top performers, and application review based on audience fit, brand alignment, and content quality.
requirements: acceptance based on audience fit, brand alignment, and content quality

opportunities.name: Whatnot Affiliate Program
opportunities.evidence: Whatnot lets eligible creators earn commission on qualifying purchases made within three days of a personalized affiliate-link click through its Impact-powered program.
requirements: 1,000+ followers or subscribers on one social platform

opportunities.name: TikTok Shop Affiliate Creator
opportunities.evidence: US TikTok Shop Affiliate Creators can access the Product Marketplace and monetize shoppable videos, profiles, and LIVE content; current policy requires at least 1,000 followers for the affiliate creator route.

opportunities.name: Amazon Associates
opportunities.evidence: Amazon Associates accepts owned websites with recent original content and certain established social networks; after application, three qualifying sales are required for application evaluation and the account can be withdrawn if no referred sale occurs within 180 days.
requirements: owned qualifying website or accepted established social presence
